about_the_game:
Master the Chakras. Master Yourself.

Sheva is a card-based fighting game with rogue-like elements, where every battle is a test of strategy and foresight. In this demo, you’ll get a hands-on look at the game’s unique combat system and core progression loop, with access to 3 of the 7 chakras featured in the full version.

Each run is a series of intense 1v1 battles, where both sides act simultaneously. Reading your opponent, predicting their moves, and adapting your strategy are key to survival.

This demo includes:

  • 3 playable chakras, each with their own enemies, themes, and card sets

  • Full access to the combat mechanics, card effects, and simultaneous turn-based system

  • A sample of the available cards and powers

  • Multiple starting skills to experiment with different playstyles

The Path to Mastery Awaits

Only those who can balance offense, defense, and foresight will conquer the chakras. Are you ready to face the challenge?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, Ubuntu 18.04, and CentOS 7
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mojave 10.14+
  • Processor: Intel or Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable GPUs
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
